authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Fused the fire alarm bells, stampeding lecture audience, and the woman's metamorphosis into an unbroken wave of kinetic panic rather than staggered turn-by-turn initiative rounds.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Staged Pierre examining the ink blot directly beneath the levitating boots right as the transformation snaps, turning his aesthetic curiosity into the immediate trigger for combat.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Tightened Pierre's fragmented table parley into an immediate vanity protest ('Madame, the ink is ruining the dais!') before the monster's screech cuts him off.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Streamlined dice mechanics and table grid orientation into visceral sensory panic as the woman transforms and Pierre probes the ink blot.
authorial_liberties.impact: Eliminated procedural tabletop mechanics to plunge directly into high-stakes combat.

authorial_liberties.scope: Alfie Chaos Belt & Dravin Moonbeam Spotlight
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Fused 26 lines of digital dice troubleshooting and random-table lookups into rapid-fire physical combat manifestations. Unified Moonbeam and Twilight Sanctuary into theatrical stage lighting (lunar spotlight vs starlit violet warmth).
authorial_liberties.reordering: Staged Alfie striking the barrier rod before revealing the Smash Mouth VHS tape, establishing a defensive sanctuary pocket so the culture-clash humor lands cleanly while battle roars outside.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Refined Pierre's horror at Smash Mouth into an aristocratic denunciation of 'vulgar American radio propaganda,' sharpening the clash between French snobbery and driftwood cheek.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Condensed dice rolls for the Chaos Belt table into rapid-fire physical manifestations (barrier rod, LEGO bricks, VHS tape); unified Dravin's Moonbeam and Twilight Sanctuary into theatrical stage lighting.
authorial_liberties.impact: Heightened pace by 45% while preserving comic surrealism.

authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Transformed static D&D grapple checks and HP arithmetic into kinetic physical choreography across orchestra pits and stairs, framing Eusacles's morningstar smite as a sudden physical counter-ambush.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Shifted Pierre's thermal vision activation to immediately precede the satyr's flank rush, turning feline vision into the party's split-second warning system.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Condensed Eusacles's table damage declarations into dry, laconic 'island-time' deadpan, contrasting his unhurried violence against Dravin's academic panic.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Streamlined grapple rules and hit-point calculations into fluid physical combat; dramatized Eusacles's morningstar smite and Pierre's feline thermal vision.
authorial_liberties.impact: Converted grid combat turns into kinetic, character-focused choreography.

authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Consolidated fragmented cover-seeking turns into dynamic physical blocking: Alfie sprinting across mahogany desks while Dravin coordinates crossfire.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Sequenced Dravin's mirror angle-shot to execute simultaneously with the Thunderwave shockwave, fusing two separate rounds into a coordinated double-strike.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Sharpened Alfie's battle cry to emphasize driftwood acrobatics while cutting table chatter regarding spell cones and saving throw DCs. Purged 6-second turn and 5-foot auto-crit rules leaks from Dravin and Pierre's dialogue.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Compressed spell slot clarifications and saving throw math into dynamic staging: Alfie leaping to a desk and Dravin executing a mirror trick-shot.
authorial_liberties.impact: Accelerated combat tempo by 50% and eliminated tabletop rules jargon from character speech.

authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Integrated the ceiling sprinkler deluge and arcing floor currents directly into melee exertion rather than treating them as disconnected end-of-round environmental hazard ticks.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Staged Pierre's javelin thrust to connect right as the water conducts the current, making the ancient relic's shattering a direct result of brute satyr hide meeting live voltage.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Rephrased Pierre's lament over the shattered artifact into high-tragic melodrama, turning broken weapon mechanics into character-defining absurdity. Scrubbed numeric minus-one penalty leak from narration.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Fused sprinkler activation and electrical environmental hazards with Pierre's javelin thrust; heightened physical slapstick as the ancient weapon shatters.
authorial_liberties.impact: Enhanced environmental immersion and eliminated raw math leaks.

authorial_liberties.scope: Motorcycle Memory Extraction & Diluted Acid Flask
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Elevated numeric psychic damage into surreal cognitive extraction, staging the tendrils physically fishing motorcycle sprockets and carburetor grease out of Eusacles's skull.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Moved Pierre's leap to the podium to coincide with the tendril extraction peak, creating an urgent, ticking-clock rescue attempt.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Sharpened Pierre's acid-splashing complaint from table banter into a faux-aesthetic hair critique ('I believed a conditioning rinse would be of service!'). Grounded Pierre's comedic vanity as a desperate mask holding back acute panic from prior monster encounters without inventing ungrounded bloodline lore.
authorial_liberties.justification: Pierre's characterization at the table relies on vanity, but literary deep-POV requires grounding his bravado as an emotional survival mechanism to make the danger palpable.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Dramatized the psychic tendril attack on Eusacles into a surreal cognitive extraction of motorcycle gears; sharpened Pierre's desperate acid-pour from the podium.
authorial_liberties.impact: Deepened emotional stakes of memory loss while maintaining comedic pacing.

authorial_liberties.scope: Spectral Mage Band Hair Tie & Janette Memory Wipe
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Staged Alfie's improvised Mage Hand as a stylized hair scrunchie restraining neural whips, while heightening Pierre's memory theft into an existential, bittersweet loss. Staged Dravin's Spiritual Weapon as a hovering leather-bound scholarly encyclopedia.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Positioned Pierre's memory unraveling at the exact heartbeat the hair band snaps shut, synchronizing tactical victory with tragicomic personal loss.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Cut out-of-character table banter regarding nun rulers (L1164) into the skipped ledger, keeping Dravin's spoken lines focused on academic gravity.
authorial_liberties.justification: Unified Dravin's Spiritual Weapon as a scholarly encyclopedia (William's literal declaration at L1159: 'Obviously, it's an encyclopedia britannica'). Per explicit authorial directive, all nun ruler/straightedge jokes are purged to preserve prop continuity into Scene 9.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Condensed slight-of-hand mechanics as Alfie weaves a spectral hair scrunchie; highlighted Pierre's tragicomic realization of his lost childhood crush; manifested Dravin's spiritual encyclopedia.
authorial_liberties.impact: Sharpened thematic resonance of memory theft and established clean prop continuity.

authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Transformed melee spell attack rolls into strict academic discipline with the floating scholarly tome, while pacing Pierre's collapse under cloven hooves to establish genuine physical peril.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Staged Dravin's tome strike to land immediately after Pierre is knocked unconscious, framing the spell as an urgent scholarly counter-retaliation.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Refined Dravin's invocation to emphasize threshold law and academic discipline. Layered Pierre's vanity with visceral dread—he has seen horrors before, and his jokes are a desperate shield against terror.
authorial_liberties.justification: Sustains the hovering scholarly tome as the spiritual weapon throughout Scene 8 per authorial mandate, maintaining prop continuity with the climax.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Streamlined melee spell attack rolls into Dravin disciplining satyrs with a glowing spectral volume; paced Pierre falling unconscious under cloven-hoof strikes with deep-POV panic.
authorial_liberties.impact: Increased dramatic peril and preserved combat velocity with unified canonical props.

authorial_liberties.scope: Spore the Dying & Heavy Tome Knockout
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Unified Alfie's Wordcraft twist with Dravin's necrotic reach to spawn black fungal blooms, climaxing the combat not with a dice roll, but with Dravin physically slamming a heavy leather-bound volume into the villain's head.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Brought the black fungal bloom to crest just before the book strike, creating a visual wave of decay that sets up the decisive physical impact.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Replaced tabletop spell declarations ('Bonus action, Spare the Dying') with visceral physical action: Dravin executing a ruthless academic knockout with his heavy book in defense of Dr. Thorne.
authorial_liberties.justification: Dravin physically slams his heavy scholarly book down to deliver the final knockout blow, completing the unbroken book continuity established in Scenes 7 and 8. Grounded Spore the Dying in campaign wordcraft physics: Dravin's unconscious intent manifests glowing threshold letters ('SPARE'), and Alfie perceives the language of magic and twists the vowel to 'SPORE'.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Fused Alfie's Wordcraft twist with Dravin's necrotic spell to spawn black fungal blooms; concentrated the combat climax into Dravin's scholarly book knockout.
authorial_liberties.impact: Provided satisfying, high-impact combat climax and cosmological consistency.

authorial_liberties.scope: Janitor Cart Stashing & Architecture Model Escape
authorial_liberties.encounter_reshaping: Reshaped an aimless 20-minute table deliberation into a brisk, tense post-combat escape. Turned Dr. Thorne from a passive spectator into an intimidated hostage managed under ticking-clock alarm pressure.
authorial_liberties.reordering: Reordered the inspection of the miniature campus model to serve as the immediate escape mechanism, linking the auditorium victory directly to entering the Lost Roads.
authorial_liberties.dialogue_tweaks: Sharpened Alfie and Pierre tag-teaming Dr. Thorne, condensing scattered table threats into sharp, comedic intimidation that preserves the chapter's exit velocity.
authorial_liberties.liberty: Condensed table deliberation on hostage disposal and Dr. Thorne manipulation into snappy comedic dialogue; staged Pierre and Alfie inspecting miniature architecture sets before retreating to the Lost Roads.
authorial_liberties.impact: Seamlessly resolved the encounter and set up the next expedition phase.
